scenarios.name: Inspect the context menu for a browser feature

scenario_steps.name: a part with a solid extrusion is active in the MCAD Software
its extrusion feature is visible in the model browser
the user right-clicks the extrusion feature in the browser
a context menu opens beside the feature row
the menu offers Edit Sketch, Edit Feature and Show Dimensions
it offers Copy, Delete, Measure and Properties
it offers Expand All Children and Collapse All Children
the extrusion row and the solid edges are highlighted
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the extrusion row and solid edges remain highlighted
